title: Tower of Dawn
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: Chaol Westfall, badly injured and cut off from the war at home, sails to a powerful southern empire in search of its famed healers. He finds a court full of rival ambitions and a healer with her own reasons for wary distrust.
readIf: you are deep into the Throne of Glass series and want to see a favourite character in a new place.
skipIf: you have not read the earlier Throne of Glass books, since this one leans on them heavily.

pairings.reason: Another big, multi-court fantasy built around powerful women, with an eastern and a western realm and plenty of politics.
Also a story of wounded people who have to rely on each other, in a sharper, faster-moving package.
Takes you to a richly imagined court in a non-European setting where outsiders must tread carefully.
